title: Open supported homology approximation
statement:
Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space (a topological space with a sheaf of commutative rings), $U\subseteq X$ an open subset, and $S$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Let $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ be an object of the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $n\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose $S_x=0$ for every $x
otin U$, where stalks are those of [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], and suppose $(H^m(K))_x=0$ for all $m
e n$ and $x\in U$. Then there are $L\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $b:L	o K$ such that $H^m(L)=0$ for all $m
e n$ and every module sheaf morphism $a:S	o H^n(K)$ factors as $H^n(b)\circ c$, for some $c:S	o H^n(L)$. No isomorphism $L\cong K$ is asserted.

proof.text: Compose exact restriction R and exact extension by zero J to obtain the exact additive endofunctor F = R followed by J on modules on X. Choose a complex P representing K. Set L = Q(F(P)) and apply Q to the chain map with components the sheaf counit epsilon(P^m), then compose with Q(P) -> K to define b. Exactness identifies H^m(L) with F(H^m(K)). The induced homology map of b is the sheaf counit, by naturality on cycles and their homology quotients. No new derived-category instance on the open is needed.

The stalk formula for the open-extension counit identifies stalks on U and gives zero stalks off U. Hence hlocal forces F(H^m(K)) to vanish for m different from n, and hsource makes epsilon(S) invertible. Define c as epsilon(S) inverse, F(a), and the inverse homology comparison. Naturality of epsilon gives c followed by H^n(b) equal to a.

proof_origin.note: Local extension-by-zero approximation; deliberately does not assert a global presentation of K. Agent expansion of the cited exact adjunction and the existing item proof plan. Blueprint search for extension by zero found no matching O_X-module approximation theorem.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib provides exact derived functors and single-complex t-structure, but no support-sensitive approximation theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: Exact extension by zero of a restriction provides a concentrated derived approximation and factors maps from supported sheaves on homology
An object in the derived category with homology only in one degree is isomorphic to its homology placed in that degree
mathlib_searches.results: DerivedCategory.exists_iso_singleFunctor_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE supplies the single-degree step, but not an open-supported approximation.

lean.statement:
theorem open_supported_homology_approximation (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    (U : Opens X) (S : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))) (n : ℤ)
    (hsource : ∀ x : X, x ∉ U → IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj S))
    (hlocal : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ n → ∀ x : X, x ∈ U →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) m).obj K))) :
    ∃ (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))) (b : L ⟶ K),
      (∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ n → IsZero
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) m).obj L)) ∧
      ∀ a : S ⟶ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) n).obj K,
        ∃ c : S ⟶ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) n).obj L,
          c ≫ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) n).map b = a
